programs.name: Computer Science BCS (Faculty of Arts & Science, St. George)
programs.a_level_offer: No grade offer published. Five IGCSE/GCSE/O Level subjects plus three different A Level/International A Level subjects (four AS subjects in place of three A Levels also considered); Math AS Level/A Level/Pure Mathematics required, other prerequisites at AS or A Level.
programs.ib_offer: No minimum total published. Complete IB Diploma with English HL or SL; Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches HL or SL, or Applications and Interpretations HL. Based on predicted or final results, excluding bonus points.
programs.ap_offer: US high school diploma from an accredited school with a rigorous course load and the highest level of prerequisite courses available. Prerequisites: Senior Year/Grade 12 English and Grade 12 Calculus or AP Calculus (AB or BC) or one semester of college calculus; Precalculus does not count. SAT/ACT optional (U of T is test optional); no AP or SAT/ACT score minimum published.
programs.required_subjects: Grade 12 English; Calculus (Ontario MCV4U equivalent; AP Calculus AB/BC for US students)
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT: tests taken on or after 21 Jan 2026 (1-6 scale) need 4.5 overall with 4.5 in Writing and 4.0 in Speaking; tests before that (old 0-120 scale) need 89 overall with 22 in each of Speaking and Writing.
programs.english_note: University-wide minimum; applies to applicants whose first language is not English and who do not qualify for an exemption (see the English language requirements page).
programs.notes: Admission category: Computer Science (OUAC code TAD), St. George, Faculty of Arts & Science. Fall 2027 entry (the pages say '2027 admissions'). U of T publishes no A Level grade or IB point offer for this category; admission is competitive and based on the overall academic record and the supplementary application (people with any post-secondary study cannot apply directly into Computer Science). Requirements by curriculum: https://future.utoronto.ca/requirements-international-high-schools and the 2027-28 International Undergraduate Admissions Bulletin https://internationalprograms.utoronto.ca/wp-content/uploads/2027-28-International-UAB.pdf. Deadlines: https://future.utoronto.ca/deadlines (apply by 15 Jan 2027, recommended early date 7 Nov 2026, documents 1 Feb 2027, Computer Science supplementary application 1 Feb 2027). FEE: intl_fee_cad 66110 is the 2026-27 approved first-year international tuition for Arts & Science (Computer Science students pay the general Arts & Science fee in year 1 and a higher fee from year 2: 69030 in 2026-27); incidental/ancillary fees and health insurance are extra. This is a 2026-27 value, not Fall 2027; the planned 2027-28 first-year Arts & Science figure is 68750 (information only, subject to change; the upper-year Computer Science fee is planned at 72480). Fee source: Tuition Fee Schedules for Publicly-Funded Programs 2026-27, Tables D1 and D2, https://planningandbudget.utoronto.ca/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/2026-27-Tuition-Fee-Report_FINAL.pdf

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering BASc (Faculty of Applied Science & Engineering)
programs.a_level_offer: Three A Levels including Mathematics and Physics; Chemistry strongly recommended as the third A Level (otherwise O Level Chemistry is required). Grades of B or higher are recommended in the prerequisite subjects; a final or predicted C or below in any prerequisite means the applicant will not be considered. Meeting this does not guarantee admission.
programs.ib_offer: Complete IB Diploma with Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches HL or SL, or Applications and Interpretations HL; AA HL strongly recommended), Chemistry, Physics and English. Minimum predicted score of at least 30 (excluding ToK and EE points) with at least 4 in the prerequisite subjects to be considered; most programs require higher scores.
programs.ap_offer: US Grade 12 at an accredited high school with SAT or ACT (all scores must be disclosed). At least a full year of: Pre-Calculus and AP Calculus AB/BC (or Calculus 12); AP Physics 1, 2 or C; AP Chemistry (or Honours/Advanced Chemistry); AP English or Grade 12 English. Competitive applicants are expected to have AP exam scores of at least 4, SAT at least 650 in each section, or ACT composite of at least 30 with at least 28 in Math and Science. No advanced standing credit for AP.
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics (including Calculus), Physics, Chemistry, English (senior level)
programs.admissions_test: Engineering Supplemental Application (ESA, due 15 Jan 2027; fee $69)
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT: tests taken on or after 21 Jan 2026 (1-6 scale) need 4.5 overall with 4.5 in Writing and 4.0 in Speaking; tests before that (old 0-120 scale) need 89 overall with 22 in each of Speaking and Writing.
programs.english_note: University-wide minimum; the Engineering English requirements page refers to the university's English language requirements page.
programs.notes: Fall 2027 entry (the Engineering page uses a September 2027 start in its examples). Engineering admits directly to Mechanical Engineering. Prerequisite courses must be completed within five years of the start date. Offers per curriculum from the Engineering out-of-country page https://discover.engineering.utoronto.ca/how-to-apply/outofcanada/ (A Level and IB entries are minimums for consideration, not offer grades; the page says most programs require higher). Deadlines: https://future.utoronto.ca/deadlines (apply 15 Jan 2027, recommended early date 7 Nov 2026, Engineering documents and ESA 15 Jan 2027). FEE: intl_fee_cad 72860 is the 2026-27 approved international tuition for Applied Science & Engineering (first-year guide: https://firstyear.engineering.utoronto.ca/finances/); incidental fees and health insurance are extra. This is a 2026-27 value, not Fall 2027; the planned 2027-28 figure is 75770 (information only, subject to change). Fee source: Tuition Fee Schedules for Publicly-Funded Programs 2026-27, Table D1, https://planningandbudget.utoronto.ca/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/2026-27-Tuition-Fee-Report_FINAL.pdf
